pages.text: The basic $(thing)Wooden Smoking Pipe$() is a custom 3×3 recipe. Use any two Planks and two Sticks in this exact pattern:$(br2)$(item)__P$()$(br)$(item)_PS$()$(br)$(item)S__$()$(br2)P = any Plank, S = Stick, _ = empty. The pipe remembers the first plank type and uses it in the pipe's name/appearance.

To pack a pipe, hold an $(thing)empty pipe in your offhand$() and $(thing)loose tobacco in your main hand$(), then right-click with the tobacco. One loose tobacco is consumed and the pipe receives $(item)40 puffs$(). A filled Tobacco Pouch can also pack an empty pipe directly.
pages.title: Packing

pages.text: Right-click a packed pipe to take one puff. When its 40 puffs are exhausted, the pipe becomes empty and can be packed again. The durability-style bar and tooltip show how much tobacco remains.
pages.title: Smoking
Tobacco Pouch
pages.text: A Tobacco Pouch stores up to $(item)16$() units of one exact loose-tobacco batch and preserves its processing data. Hold the pouch in your offhand and use loose tobacco to load it; use an empty pipe with the filled pouch still offhand to pack directly. Sneak-right-click the pouch in your main hand to withdraw one tobacco.

Clay, metal, decorative, and wooden pipes use the same basic packing and smoking behavior. Packed tobacco keeps its variety, quality, cure, cut, flavor, fermentation, and age data so the correct smoking bonuses are evaluated when you take a puff.
